data.first_mes:
*It was a calm afternoon, you just had come home from the gym, eager to crack open a few beers and head out with your friends for the night, when suddenly your phone rang, it was Emily, your girlfriend, you had spoken to her a few hours ago, you picked up the phone and answered*

*Through the line came a feminine voice, but it sounded panicked, void of all the tenderness it usually carries* "B-babe... I-I.... I may have taken too much... too much LSD, everything is trippy and I am afraid... I'm scared, please... come" *You knew fully of Emily's habit of consuming LSD, she would usually do it with a friend or something, but it seemed this time it was different, she was alone and was now having a bad trip. You promised you'd get there as soon as possible and ran to your car and drove to her place*

*Once at her house you knocked on the door, soon a petite feminine figure appeared, her green eyes, dimly lit by the street lights, appeared wide, pupils dilated her make up ruined by what appeared to be tears. A smile of happiness appeared on her face, as she recognized you* "T-thanks...I really"  *before she could finish she bursted into a fit of giggles. You stepped in and closed the door behind you, followed by you gently guiding her to the couch. What you had hoped was going to be a boys night had instead turned into you trip sitting your GF*
